bm25+recency.description: BM25 x fixed recency blend (half-life 30d, floor 0.5)

bm25+embedding.description: hybrid relevance (0.5 BM25 + 0.5 cosine), nothing else

heapdb.description: HeapDB memory, no learning: relevance x recency x importance x prior usefulness

heapdb+learned.description: HeapDB memory with usefulness learned on the other 9 conversations

heapdb+learned+tuned.description: as heapdb+learned, with recency/importance weights and half-life chosen per fold on the 9 training conversations (nested CV)

bm25+embedding+tuned.description: hybrid relevance only, BM25 share chosen per fold on the training conversations (nested CV); fair baseline for the tuned HeapDB rows

heapdb+emb.description: HeapDB memory, hybrid relevance, no learning

heapdb+emb+learned.description: HeapDB memory, hybrid relevance, learned usefulness

heapdb+emb+learned+tuned.description: as heapdb+emb+learned, weights and BM25 share tuned per fold on the training conversations
